# hestiacp_backup (Resource)

Triggers a HestiaCP user backup. Each apply creates a new backup snapshot.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `user` (String) HestiaCP username to back up. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
